newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Herald to buy Coolgardie gold assets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Herald to buy Coolgardie gold assets.

text.p: Herald Resources NL said on Monday it has reached an agreement in principle to purchase Coolgardie Gold NL's 50 percent stake in the assets of Gold Mines of Coolgardie Pty Ltd for A$14.8 million.
Herald already holds the other 50 percent of Gold Mines of Coolgardie.

The assets include two gold treatment plants and four mine pits in Western Australia, which last year produced 91,000 ounces of gold, Michael Wright, executive director of Herald Resources, told Reuters.
The sale is subject to the approval of shareholders and a final purchase agreement, the company said.
If approved, the sale would be back-dated to December 31, 1996, Herald said.
